attributes.name: drawing_number
attributes.description: Engineering drawing number for 2D technical documentation. References detailed manufacturing and inspection drawings.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current component revision becomes effective for use in new designs and BOMs. Supports ECO implementation.

attributes.name: functional_group
attributes.description: Functional classification of the component within the product architecture. Used for design reuse and modular engineering.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, and disposal procedures.

attributes.name: height_mm
attributes.description: Maximum height dimension of the component envelope in millimeters. Part of dimensional specification for packaging and assembly planning.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Procurement or manufacturing lead time in calendar days. Used for MRP planning and order scheduling.

attributes.name: length_mm
attributes.description: Maximum length dimension of the component envelope in millimeters. Part of dimensional specification for packaging and assembly planning.

attributes.name: lifecycle_phase
attributes.description: Current phase in the component lifecycle from concept through obsolescence. Governs release status and usage authorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|design|prototype|validation|production|phase_out|obsolete — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production or procurement lot size. Defines batch quantity for manufacturing execution and inventory replenishment.

attributes.name: make_or_buy
attributes.description: Strategic sourcing decision indicating whether the component is manufactured in-house, purchased from suppliers, or both.

attributes.name: material_specification
attributes.description: Material composition and grade specification. Defines raw material requirements for manufactured components.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by supplier or manufacturing process. Constraint for procurement and production planning.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the engineer who last modified the component record. Audit trail for change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the component record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data currency.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the component. Primary human-readable identifier used in engineering documentation and BOMs.

attributes.name: obsolescence_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the component will be obsoleted and no longer available for new designs. Supports lifecycle planning.

attributes.name: pfmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the PFMEA document analyzing potential manufacturing process failure modes and controls.

tag_set.value: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) Reference

attributes.name: plm_item_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this component in Siemens Teamcenter PLM system. External system reference for PLM integration.

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates compliance with EU REACH regulation for chemical substance registration and safety assessment.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Engineering release status indicating approval state for manufacturing and procurement use.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers replenishment action. Calculated from lead time demand and safety stock.

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Current engineering revision level of the component. Tracks design changes through ECO/ECN processes.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates compliance with EU RoHS directive restricting use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum inventory buffer quantity to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Input to MRP calculations.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard unit cost for the component in base currency. Used for BOM costing, inventory valuation, and financial planning.

attributes.name: technology_family
attributes.description: Engineering technology classification grouping components by functional domain (e.g., electrification, automation, control systems).

attributes.name: tolerance_class
attributes.description: Manufacturing tolerance classification defining acceptable dimensional variation. Drives manufacturing process selection and quality inspection requirements.

attributes.name: ul_certification_number
attributes.description: UL certification identifier for product safety compliance. Required for electrical components in North American markets.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for inventory, procurement, and BOM quantity calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|G|M|CM|L|ML|SET|KIT — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of a single component unit in kilograms. Used for logistics planning, shipping cost calculation, and product specifications.

attributes.name: width_mm
attributes.description: Maximum width dimension of the component envelope in millimeters. Part of dimensional specification for packaging and assembly planning.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the engineer who created the component record in PLM. Audit trail for data governance.

products.name: bom
products.description: Bill of Materials master record defining the structured product hierarchy for a given component or finished assembly at a specific revision. Captures BOM type (engineering BOM, manufacturing BOM, service BOM), effectivity dates, quantity basis, unit of measure, and the owning PLM item. Acts as the SSOT for product structure consumed by MRP, MES, and production planning.
products.reference: SAP PP BOM / Teamcenter BOM Management

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Bill of Materials record. Primary key for the BOM master data entity.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: A BOM master record defines the structured product hierarchy FOR a specific top-level component or assembly. This is the foundational PLM relationship — every BOM belongs to a parent component. The bo

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Customer‑specific BOMs are created for contract fulfillment; linking BOM to customer_account enables contract‑BOM reconciliation reports.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: BOM explosion, MRP, and cost rollup require knowing which material_master record (the parent assembly) a BOM belongs to. In ERP systems, every BOM header is registered against a parent material number

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_project. Business justification: A Bill of Materials is developed and released within the context of an engineering project. Linking bom to engineering_project enables project-level BOM traceability and supports program management re

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse. Business justification: BOMs in manufacturing are plant/warehouse-specific; the same assembly may have different BOMs per plant. MRP and production planning require resolving bom.plant_code to a warehouse record. The existin

attributes.name: alternative_bom_indicator
attributes.description: Identifier for alternative BOM variants of the same product, used to represent different manufacturing methods, material substitutions, or regional variations. Blank for primary BOM.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the BOM in the engineering change workflow. Pending indicates awaiting review, Approved means released for use, Rejected means not accepted, Conditional means approved with restrictions or prerequisites.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved this BOM revision. Supports audit trail and accountability for engineering change management.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this BOM revision was formally approved for release. Critical for traceability and compliance with engineering change control processes.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The fundamental unit of measure in which the finished product is stocked and sold, independent of the BOM quantity basis. Used for inventory and sales order processing.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM, typically a human-readable code used across engineering, manufacturing, and procurement systems. Serves as the externally-known unique reference.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the BOM. Draft indicates work in progress, In Review means under engineering approval, Approved is ready for release, Active is in production use, Obsolete is no longer valid, Superseded has been replaced by a newer revision, and Frozen is locked for regulatory or contractual reasons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|obsolete|superseded|frozen — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended business purpose. Engineering BOM (EBOM) represents design intent, Manufacturing BOM (MBOM) reflects shop floor assembly, Service BOM supports after-sales maintenance, Sales BOM defines customer-facing configurations, Planning BOM is used for MRP, and As-Maintained BOM tracks actual installed configurations.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the BOM structure. Material BOM lists physical components, Document BOM references technical drawings and specifications, Equipment BOM defines installed assets, Variant BOM supports product families, Configurable BOM enables customer-specific selections.

attributes.name: configuration_profile
attributes.description: Identifier for a variant configuration profile or product family definition. Used in configurable BOMs to define which components are included based on customer selections or feature options.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the BOM cost estimate. Supports multi-currency costing for global manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_total
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of the BOM including all material, labor, and overhead components. Rolled up from component costs and routing operations. Used for product costing and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was first created in the PLM system. Provides audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the BOM, providing additional context about the product structure, manufacturing method, or special handling requirements. Supplements the BOM number and type.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM revision becomes valid and can be used for production planning, procurement, and manufacturing execution. Supports time-phased BOM management for product transitions.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this BOM revision remains valid. Nullable for open-ended BOMs. Used to manage phase-out of legacy product structures and ensure correct BOM selection in MRP and MES systems.

attributes.name: engineering_change_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the ECO that created or last modified this BOM revision. Provides traceability to the engineering change management process and links to ECO approval workflows.

attributes.name: explosion_type
attributes.description: Defines how the BOM structure should be expanded for planning and execution. Single Level shows only immediate children, Multi Level recursively expands all sub-assemblies, Summarized aggregates quantities across all levels.

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this BOM supports variant configuration, allowing customer-specific or order-specific component selection. True for configurable BOMs, False for fixed BOMs.

attributes.name: is_critical_bom
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this BOM is for a critical or high-value product requiring special handling, approval workflows, or regulatory compliance. True for critical BOMs, False for standard BOMs.

attributes.name: is_phantom_bom
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a phantom (transient) BOM that is not stocked as a discrete item but is exploded through to its components during MRP and production. True for phantom BOMs, False for standard stocked assemblies.

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production lot or batch size for which this BOM is optimized. Used in MRP calculations to determine component requirements and setup costs. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that last modified this BOM record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was last updated. Distinct from approval and effectivity dates. Provides audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or instructions related to this BOM. May include manufacturing guidelines, quality requirements, or special handling instructions for production planning and shop floor execution.

attributes.name: plm_item_code
attributes.description: Reference to the owning PLM item in Siemens Teamcenter that this BOM structure represents. Links the BOM to its parent product or assembly definition.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Identifier linking this BOM to a specific production version in SAP PP, which combines a BOM with a routing to define a complete manufacturing process. Supports multiple production methods for the same product.

attributes.name: quantity_basis
attributes.description: The base quantity for which this BOM is defined, typically 1 for single-unit BOMs or a batch size for process manufacturing. All component quantities in the BOM structure are expressed relative to this basis.

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Revision level or version identifier for this BOM structure. Tracks engineering changes and ensures traceability across ECO and ECN processes. Critical for change management and configuration control.

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage at the BOM header level, applied to all components. Used in MRP to inflate material requirements. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The primary key or unique identifier of this BOM record in the source system. Enables bidirectional traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational PLM system.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity basis, such as EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter). Must align with the PLM item and material master UOM definitions.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Defines the business context in which this BOM is intended to be used. Production for shop floor execution, Costing for standard cost calculation, Engineering for design and development, Maintenance for service and repair, Sales Order for customer-specific configurations, Project for one-time builds.

attributes.name: weight_total
attributes.description: Total weight of the finished assembly including all components, calculated from the BOM structure. Used for logistics planning, freight cost estimation, and product specifications.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total BOM weight. KG (kilogram), LB (pound), G (gram), OZ (ounce), MT (metric ton).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that originally created this BOM record. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

products.name: bom_line
products.description: Individual line item within a Bill of Materials, representing a single parent-child component relationship. Captures position number, find number, quantity per assembly, unit of measure, reference designator, substitute component references (approved alternates with qualification status and usage restrictions), phantom flag, effectivity start/end dates, and engineering notes. Enables full BOM explosion and implosion queries for MRP, supports alternate sourcing without ECO, and provides the granular structure for production routing and cost rollup.

attributes.name: bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the BOM line entity representing a single parent-child component relationship within a bill of materials structure.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.bom. Business justification: bom_line represents a line item belonging to a BOM; adding bom_id creates the required parent-child relationship and eliminates the BOM silo.

attributes.name: primary_engineering_component_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent assembly or product that contains this component. Represents the 'parent' side of the parent-child relationship in the BOM structure.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. Business justification: Each BOM line item references a component at a specific revision level — effectivity is controlled by revision. The engineering_bom_line table currently stores revision_level as a STRING denormalized

attributes.name: tertiary_engineering_substitute_component_id
attributes.description: Reference to an approved alternate component that can be used in place of the primary component without requiring an Engineering Change Order (ECO). Enables flexible sourcing and supply chain continuity.

attributes.name: assembly_instruction
attributes.description: Specific instructions for assembling or installing this component into the parent assembly. May reference work instructions, torque specifications, or special tooling requirements.

attributes.name: bulk_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a bulk material (e.g., paint, adhesive, lubricant) that is consumed in variable quantities and may not be tracked at individual unit level.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: The Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN) number that introduced or last modified this BOM line. Provides traceability to engineering change governance processes.

attributes.name: co_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line represents a co-product or by-product that is produced alongside the main assembly. Co-products have negative quantities in the BOM and represent outputs rather than inputs.

attributes.name: cost_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost of this component should be included in the parent assembly cost rollup calculation. Some components (e.g., reference items, tooling) may be excluded from product costing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical to product functionality, safety, or regulatory compliance. Critical components may require additional quality controls, traceability, or supply chain management.

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this component is no longer effective in the parent assembly. Used to manage engineering changes and phase-out of obsolete components. Null indicates the component is currently effective with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_number_end
attributes.description: The ending serial number of the parent assembly for which this component is effective. Null indicates the component remains effective for all subsequent serial numbers.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_number_start
attributes.description: The starting serial number of the parent assembly for which this component is effective. Enables serial-number-based effectivity control for mid-production engineering changes.

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this component becomes effective in the parent assembly. Used to manage engineering changes and phase-in of new components without creating new BOM versions.

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line. Indicates whether the component relationship is currently in use, pending approval, or has been superseded.

attributes.name: engineering_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from engineering regarding special assembly instructions, design considerations, quality requirements, or other technical information relevant to this component usage.

attributes.name: find_number
attributes.description: Reference designator or callout number used to locate this component on engineering drawings, assembly diagrams, and technical documentation. Also known as item number or balloon number.

attributes.name: fixed_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of parent assembly batch size. When true, the quantity does not scale with production order quantity (e.g., setup materials, tooling).

attributes.name: installation_point
attributes.description: The specific location or mounting point within the parent assembly where this component is installed. Used in assembly instructions and maintenance documentation.

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: The number of days before the parent assembly start date that this component must be available. Used in production scheduling and material requirements planning (MRP) to ensure timely component availability.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system account that last modified this BOM line record. Used for audit trail and change management purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: phantom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a phantom (transient) assembly that is not stocked or tracked in inventory. Phantom items are exploded through to their child components during MRP processing.

attributes.name: position_number
attributes.description: Sequential position or line number of this component within the parent assembly BOM. Used for ordering and identifying components in engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how this component is obtained: manufactured in-house (make), purchased from suppliers (buy), transferred from another plant (transfer), or subcontracted to external manufacturers.

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The number of units of this component required to build one unit of the parent assembly. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) calculations and cost rollup.

attributes.name: reference_designator
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific location or function of the component in the assembly (e.g., R1, C5, U3 for electronics; A-01, B-12 for mechanical). Used in assembly instructions and maintenance documentation.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during assembly or manufacturing. Used to adjust material requirements planning (MRP) calculations to account for normal production losses.

attributes.name: sort_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display order of BOM lines in reports, pick lists, and assembly instructions. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: substitute_qualification_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the substitute component for use in this assembly. Indicates whether the alternate has passed qualification testing and is approved for production use.

attributes.name: substitute_usage_restriction
attributes.description: Conditions or limitations on when the substitute component may be used (e.g., only for specific customer orders, only when primary is unavailable, geographic restrictions). Ensures proper alternate sourcing governance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the component quantity is expressed (e.g., each, kilogram, meter, liter). Must align with the component material master UOM for accurate MRP and inventory calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|G|L|ML|M|CM|FT|IN|SET|PAIR|BOX|ROLL|SHEET — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system account that created this BOM line record. Used for audit trail and change management purposes.

products.name: cad_model
products.description: Master record for CAD/CAM design files managed in PLM, including 3D solid models, 2D drawings, simulation files, and CAM toolpath files. Tracks file format (STEP, JT, NX, DXF), revision, authoring tool version, model maturity state, associated component, dataset type, file size, and vault storage reference. Supports DFM analysis input and downstream CAM programming.

attributes.name: cad_model_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CAD/CAM design file record in the PLM system.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufactured component or assembly that this CAD model represents.

attributes.name: eco_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.eco. Business justification: CAD models are revised and released under Engineering Change Orders. The cad_model table currently stores eco_number as a STRING denormalized reference. Adding a proper FK eco_id to eco normalizes thi

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. Business justification: A CAD model is associated with a specific revision state of a component in PLM. Linking cad_model to engineering_revision establishes the authoritative revision context for each CAD dataset, enabling

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the engineering manager or authority who approved the CAD model for release to manufacturing.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CAD model was formally approved for release to manufacturing.

attributes.name: authoring_tool
attributes.description: Name of the CAD software application used to create the model (e.g., Siemens NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, AutoCAD).

attributes.name: authoring_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CAD authoring software used to create or last modify the model, critical for file compatibility and migration planning.

attributes.name: bounding_box_height
attributes.description: Maximum height dimension of the CAD model bounding box, used for spatial analysis and packaging planning.

attributes.name: bounding_box_length
attributes.description: Maximum length dimension of the CAD model bounding box, used for spatial analysis and packaging planning.

attributes.name: bounding_box_width
attributes.description: Maximum width dimension of the CAD model bounding box, used for spatial analysis and packaging planning.

attributes.name: cam_program_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the associated CAM toolpath program generated from this CAD model for CNC machining operations.

attributes.name: cam_programming_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this CAD model requires CAM toolpath programming for CNC machining or other automated manufacturing processes.

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_x
attributes.description: X-coordinate of the calculated center of gravity for the 3D model, used for balance and assembly analysis.

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_y
attributes.description: Y-coordinate of the calculated center of gravity for the 3D model, used for balance and assembly analysis.

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_z
attributes.description: Z-coordinate of the calculated center of gravity for the 3D model, used for balance and assembly analysis.

attributes.name: checksum_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the CAD file content, used for integrity verification and change detection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CAD model record was first created in the PLM system.

attributes.name: dataset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CAD dataset indicating whether it is a 3D solid model, 2D drawing, assembly, simulation file, or CAM toolpath file.

attributes.name: design_intent
attributes.description: Engineering rationale and functional requirements that guided the design of this CAD model, supporting Design for Manufacturability (DFM) analysis.

attributes.name: dfm_analysis_status
attributes.description: Status of the Design for Manufacturability analysis for this CAD model, indicating whether the design has been reviewed for manufacturing feasibility.

attributes.name: dfm_complexity_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the manufacturing complexity of the design, derived from DFM analysis (higher scores indicate more complex manufacturing requirements).

attributes.name: drawing_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the associated 2D engineering drawing derived from or related to this CAD model.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification number assigned to this CAD model for international trade compliance, if applicable.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Native file format of the CAD model (e.g., STEP for neutral exchange, JT for visualization, NX for native Siemens format, DXF for 2D drawings). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STEP|JT|NX|DXF|DWG|IGES|STL|Parasolid|CATIA|SolidWorks — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the CAD model file in bytes, used for storage planning and data transfer optimization.

attributes.name: intellectual_property_owner
attributes.description: Legal entity or business unit that owns the intellectual property rights to this CAD model design.

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this CAD model contains proprietary or confidential design information requiring restricted access controls.

attributes.name: material_specification
attributes.description: Specification of the material to be used for manufacturing the component represented by this CAD model (e.g., steel grade, aluminum alloy, polymer type).

attributes.name: model_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the CAD model, including its purpose, key features, and design intent.

attributes.name: model_mass
attributes.description: Calculated mass of the component based on model volume and material density, used for weight analysis and shipping planning.

attributes.name: model_maturity_state
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CAD model indicating its readiness for manufacturing (e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Released, Obsolete).

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the CAD model file as assigned by the design engineer.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or part number associated with this CAD model, used for cross-referencing with BOM and engineering documentation.

attributes.name: model_surface_area
attributes.description: Calculated surface area of the 3D model, used for coating, painting, and finishing process planning.

attributes.name: model_volume
attributes.description: Calculated volume of the 3D solid model, used for material estimation and weight calculation.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the design engineer who last modified the CAD model.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CAD model was last modified or updated in the PLM system.

attributes.name: obsolete_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CAD model was marked as obsolete and superseded by a newer revision.

attributes.name: released_timestamp

products.name: eco
products.description: Engineering Change Order — the formal governance record initiating, tracking, approving, and closing a controlled change to a released product design. Captures ECO number, change type (design, material, process), priority, reason code, affected items with disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, retrofit), effectivity date, cost/schedule impact, initiator, approver chain, closure status, and revision transition (from/to). Includes affected item detail: item reference, type, current/proposed revision, disposition action, quantity affected, and implementation status per item. Upon approval, also serves as the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) — the formal communication record distributed to production, supply chain, quality, and supplier portals capturing notification distribution list, acknowledgement tracking, implementation date, and affected BOM/drawing revisions. SSOT for engineering change governance and change communication per ISO 9001 change control requirements.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria

attributes.name: applicable_standards

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: change_reason

attributes.name: confidentiality_level

products.name: project_component_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment relationship between engineering projects and components in the product development lifecycle. It captures which components are being developed, modified, or validated as part of which engineering projects. Each record links one engineering project to one component with attributes that exist only in the context of this development assignment, including the role of the component in the project, development status, target revision, assigned engineer, and milestone dates.. Existence Justification: In manufacturing PLM operations, engineering projects develop multiple components simultaneously (a new product platform may involve hundreds of components), and components participate in multiple projects over their lifecycle (a motor component may be used in initial development, then cost-reduction projects, then validation projects for different product families). The business actively manages project-component assignments as a core PLM workflow, tracking which engineer is responsible for which component in which project, the development status, target revision, and milestone dates.

products.name: ncr
products.description: Non-Conformance Report (NCR) serving as the single, unified quality event record for ALL deviations from specifications, standards, or requirements regardless of detection source or reporting channel. Encompasses internal defects, customer complaints (including 8D problem-solving), supplier non-conformances, field returns/RMA dispositions, and audit-triggered findings. Captures non-conformance type (internal/customer/supplier/field-return/audit), affected material/product/serial number, detection source (incoming inspection, in-process, final inspection, field/customer, audit, supplier delivery), severity classification, containment actions, root cause analysis, disposition decision (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return-to-supplier, repair, replace, credit, no-fault-found), RMA tracking fields (return authorization number, customer reference, repair actions, return shipment status), SAP QM notification type mapping (Q1/Q2/Q3), and linkage to CAPA for corrective/preventive action. Supports 8D methodology for customer-facing issues. Aligned with ISO 9001 clause 8.7 (control of nonconforming outputs), clause 10.2 (corrective action), and integrates with Salesforce Service Cloud for customer-originated events.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the non-conformance based on impact to safety, quality, regulatory compliance, or customer satisfaction: critical (safety/regulatory risk), major (significant quality impact), minor (limited impact), observation (potential risk noted).

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the NCR is expected to be fully closed, including all corrective actions verified. Used for SLA tracking and escalation management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the NCR record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

products.name: capa
products.description: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record managing the full lifecycle of quality improvement actions triggered by NCRs, audit findings, customer complaints, or internal quality events. Tracks root cause analysis (5-Why, Ishikawa), corrective action plan, preventive action plan, responsible owner, target dates, verification of effectiveness, and closure status per ISO 9001 clause 10.2.
products.reference: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) / ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record. Primary key for the capa data product in the quality domain.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: CAPA actions are often triggered by defects in a particular component; linking enables root‑cause tracking and corrective action reporting.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_contact. Business justification: Customer-related CAPAs (8D reports) require specific customer contact for effectiveness verification sign-off and closure approval. Real scenario: automotive 8D process mandates customer quality engin

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer associated with this CAPA when triggered by a customer complaint, field failure, or warranty claim. Links to the customer account for customer-facing quality reporting and Salesforce CRM integration.

attributes.name: eco_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.eco. Business justification: eco_number exists as a denormalized field on capa, directly signaling this relationship. CAPAs for design-related root causes trigger ECOs. Replacing the free-text eco_number with a proper FK enables

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) that triggered this CAPA. Establishes the traceability link between the nonconformity detection record and the corrective action response.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: CAPA actions address root causes of defects on a particular product SKU; linking provides product‑centric corrective action tracking.

attributes.name: action_implementation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the corrective and/or preventive actions were fully implemented in the production process or quality system. Marks the transition from planning to execution phase.

attributes.name: actual_closure_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the CAPA was formally closed after successful verification of effectiveness. Null if the CAPA is still open. Used to calculate actual cycle time versus target.

attributes.name: affected_process_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing process, work center, or production routing step where the nonconformity was detected or originated. Sourced from SAP PP routing or Siemens Opcenter MES process definition.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CAPA was formally approved for closure by the authorized quality approver. Represents the final lifecycle milestone before the record is archived.

attributes.name: capa_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the CAPA record, typically formatted as CAPA-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in communications, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Sourced from SAP QM notification numbering.

attributes.name: capa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CAPA record. Tracks progression from initial creation through root cause analysis, action implementation, effectiveness verification, and formal closure per ISO 9001 Clause 10.2.

attributes.name: capa_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the action is corrective (addressing an existing nonconformity), preventive (eliminating a potential nonconformity), or both. Drives workflow routing and reporting in SAP QM.

attributes.name: containment_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which all immediate containment actions were completed and verified. Used to measure response speed and compliance with customer-mandated containment timelines.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the permanent corrective actions planned to eliminate the root cause of the nonconformity and prevent recurrence. Includes process changes, design modifications, procedure updates, or training interventions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was first created in the quality management system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer was formally notified of the nonconformity and the corrective action plan. Null if customer notification is not required or has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer must be formally notified of the nonconformity and the corrective action taken. Driven by customer contract requirements, product safety implications, or regulatory obligations.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department or cost center responsible for the process or area where the nonconformity originated. Used for departmental quality KPI reporting and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: effectiveness_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the effectiveness of the implemented actions was formally verified and documented. Required for CAPA closure per ISO 9001 Clause 10.2.

attributes.name: effectiveness_verification_method
attributes.description: Description of the method used to verify that the implemented corrective and preventive actions were effective in eliminating the root cause and preventing recurrence. May include SPC monitoring, re-audit, production run data review, or customer feedback analysis.

attributes.name: effectiveness_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corrective and preventive actions have been formally verified as effective. True when verification is complete and documented; False when verification is pending or failed. Required gate for CAPA closure.

attributes.name: immediate_containment_action
attributes.description: Description of the short-term containment actions taken immediately upon detection of the nonconformity to prevent further defective product from reaching the customer or next process step. Corresponds to D3 in the 8D methodology.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the CAPA was formally opened and initiated. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the CAPA lifecycle. Used to calculate cycle time and compliance with response time SLAs.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the CAPA record. Used for change detection in incremental data pipeline loads and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Summary of key lessons learned from the CAPA investigation and resolution that should be shared across the organization to prevent similar issues. Feeds into the knowledge management and APQP process for future product launches.

attributes.name: n8d_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal 8D (Eight Disciplines) problem-solving report associated with this CAPA, if applicable. Used when customer-mandated 8D reporting is required, particularly in automotive and industrial OEM supply chains.

attributes.name: ppap_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA requires a new or revised Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submission due to process or design changes resulting from the corrective action. Relevant for automotive and industrial OEM supply chains.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Impact Flag

attributes.name: preventive_action_plan
attributes.description: Description of proactive actions planned to eliminate the causes of potential nonconformities before they occur. Addresses systemic risks identified during root cause analysis that may affect similar processes or products.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the CAPA based on risk severity, customer impact, regulatory exposure, or recurrence frequency. Drives escalation timelines and resource allocation.

attributes.name: problem_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the nonconformity, defect, or quality event that triggered the CAPA. Includes observed symptoms, affected product or process, and initial impact assessment. Corresponds to the problem statement in the 8D or CAPA methodology.

attributes.name: quality_standard_reference
attributes.description: The specific quality standard clause, regulatory requirement, or customer specification that was violated or is being addressed by this CAPA. Examples: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2, IATF 16949, customer-specific quality requirements.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA addresses a recurring nonconformity that has been previously reported. True if the same or similar root cause has been identified in a prior CAPA. Used for chronic problem identification and escalation.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA has regulatory reporting implications, such as mandatory notification to ISO certification bodies, OSHA, EPA, or CE/UL certification authorities. Triggers compliance escalation workflow when True.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_method
attributes.description: The structured methodology used to identify the root cause of the nonconformity. Common methods include 5-Why, Ishikawa (fishbone) diagram, 8D problem solving, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), fault tree analysis, or Pareto analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 5_why|ishikawa|8d|fmea|fault_tree|pareto|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause using the 6M Ishikawa framework: Man (human error), Machine (equipment), Material (raw material/component), Method (process/procedure), Measurement (inspection/calibration), or Environment (facility/conditions). Enables systemic trend analysis.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the identified root cause(s) of the nonconformity as determined through the root cause analysis. This is the foundational finding that drives the corrective action plan.

attributes.name: source_reference_number
attributes.description: The identifier of the originating document or record that triggered this CAPA, such as an NCR number, audit finding reference, customer complaint ticket number, or SAP QM notification number. Enables traceability back to the triggering event.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Category of the triggering event that initiated the CAPA. Indicates whether the CAPA originated from a Non-Conformance Report (NCR), customer complaint, internal or external audit finding, shop floor quality event, supplier quality issue, or regulatory inspection finding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ncr|customer_complaint|audit_finding|internal_quality_event|supplier_issue|regulatory_finding|field_failure|warranty_claim — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: The planned date by which all corrective and preventive actions must be implemented and verified as effective. Used for on-time closure KPI tracking and escalation management.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the quality problem or improvement opportunity addressed by this CAPA. Used in dashboards, reports, and management reviews.

products.name: fmea
products.description: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) master record covering both DFMEA (Design FMEA) and PFMEA (Process FMEA). Stores failure modes, effects, causes, current controls, severity/occurrence/detection ratings, Risk Priority Number (RPN), recommended actions, and revised RPN after action implementation. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and aligned with AIAG-VDA FMEA methodology.

attributes.name: fmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) ID
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the FMEA record. Primary key for the fmea data product in the quality domain.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) ID

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated CAPA record initiated as a result of this FMEA recommended action. Links the FMEA to the formal corrective action management process in SAP QM or the quality management system.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: DFMEAs are component-specific. part_name and part_number on fmea are denormalized signals of this relationship. Linking fmea to the engineering component master enables design-quality traceability, su

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or OEM for whom this FMEA is being prepared. Customer-specific FMEA requirements (e.g., Ford, GM, Stellantis CSRs) may impose additional rating criteria or documentation standards.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_project. Business justification: DFMEAs and PFMEAs are initiated as deliverables within APQP engineering projects. The engineering project defines the FMEA scope, timeline, and team. APQP Phase 2 explicitly requires FMEA completion a

attributes.name: quality_ppap_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PPAP submission package that includes this FMEA as a required deliverable. The FMEA is a mandatory PPAP element per AIAG PPAP 4th Edition. Links quality analysis to the formal part approval process.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or component that is the subject of this FMEA analysis. Links the FMEA to the product master record managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: action_priority
attributes.description: AIAG-VDA Action Priority classification (High, Medium, Low) assigned to the failure mode based on the combination of Severity, Occurrence, and Detection ratings. Replaces the legacy RPN-only prioritization approach introduced in the 2019 AIAG-VDA FMEA Handbook. Core AIAG-VDA Step 7 field.

attributes.name: action_taken
attributes.description: Description of the actual corrective or preventive action implemented to address the failure mode. Documents what was done versus what was recommended, enabling traceability for PPAP and audit purposes. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recommended action was actually implemented and verified as complete. Compared against target_completion_date to measure action closure timeliness. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FMEA was formally reviewed and approved by the responsible engineering and quality authority. Required for PPAP submission and regulatory compliance documentation. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the FMEA record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: current_detection_controls
attributes.description: Description of existing design verification or process monitoring controls that detect the failure mode or cause before the product reaches the customer. Examples include inspection plans, SPC monitoring, functional testing, and CMM measurement. Core AIAG-VDA Step 7 field.

attributes.name: current_prevention_controls
attributes.description: Description of existing design or process controls that prevent the failure cause from occurring or reduce the occurrence rate. Examples include design standards, material specifications, process parameters, and mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) devices. Core AIAG-VDA Step 6 field.

attributes.name: detection_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating (1–10) assessing the ability of current controls to detect the failure cause or failure mode before the product reaches the customer. A rating of 10 indicates no detection capability; 1 indicates near-certain detection. Core AIAG-VDA Step 7 field.

attributes.name: failure_cause
attributes.description: Root cause or mechanism that leads to the failure mode. Describes the specific design weakness, process deficiency, or material condition that initiates the failure (e.g., 'insufficient weld penetration', 'incorrect torque specification'). Core AIAG-VDA Step 4 field.

attributes.name: failure_effect
attributes.description: Description of the consequence of the failure mode on the customer, end user, or downstream process. Defines what the customer experiences when the failure occurs (e.g., 'loss of function', 'noise', 'injury risk'). Core AIAG-VDA Step 4 field.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: The specific manner in which the item, component, or process step could potentially fail to perform its intended function. Represents the physical or chemical description of the failure (e.g., 'fracture', 'short circuit', 'dimensional out-of-tolerance'). Core AIAG-VDA Step 4 field.

attributes.name: fmea_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable document control number assigned to the FMEA record in Siemens Teamcenter PLM. Used for cross-referencing in engineering change orders (ECOs), PPAP packages, and APQP deliverables.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Number

attributes.name: fmea_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the FMEA document within the Siemens Teamcenter PLM workflow. Controls whether the FMEA is editable, under review, formally released for production use, or retired.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Status

attributes.name: fmea_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Type
attributes.description: Classification of the FMEA by analysis scope: DFMEA (Design FMEA) evaluates design-related failure modes; PFMEA (Process FMEA) evaluates manufacturing process failure modes; SFMEA (System FMEA) evaluates system-level interactions; MFMEA (Machinery FMEA) evaluates equipment failure modes. Aligned with AIAG-VDA methodology.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Type

attributes.name: function_description
attributes.description: Description of the intended function or purpose of the item, component, or process step being analyzed. Defines what the element is supposed to do under normal operating conditions. Core AIAG-VDA Step 3 field.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FMEA analysis was formally initiated or first created. Marks the start of the FMEA lifecycle and is used for APQP timing and project milestone tracking. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of the FMEA. FMEAs must be reviewed and updated when design or process changes occur, when field failures are reported, or on a scheduled basis per the quality management system. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: occurrence_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating (1–10) estimating the likelihood or frequency of the failure cause occurring. A rating of 10 indicates near-certain occurrence; 1 indicates extremely unlikely. Based on historical failure data, process capability (Cp/Cpk), or engineering judgment. Core AIAG-VDA Step 6 field.

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: Name or description of the specific manufacturing process step or operation being analyzed in a PFMEA (e.g., 'Welding Station 3', 'CNC Milling Op 20'). Derived from the process routing in SAP S/4HANA PP or Siemens Opcenter MES.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Proposed corrective or preventive action to reduce the severity, occurrence, or detection rating of the failure mode. Drives CAPA initiation and engineering change orders (ECOs). Core AIAG-VDA Step 8 field.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the failure mode is associated with a regulatory compliance requirement (e.g., CE Marking, UL certification, EPA, OSHA). Failure modes with this flag require documented evidence of control effectiveness in regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: revised_action_priority
attributes.description: Updated AIAG-VDA Action Priority (High, Medium, Low) recalculated after implementation of the recommended action. Confirms whether the residual risk level is acceptable or requires further action.

attributes.name: revised_detection_rating
attributes.description: Updated detection rating (1–10) after implementation of the recommended action. Reflects improved detection capability resulting from new controls, inspection methods, or monitoring systems. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: revised_occurrence_rating
attributes.description: Updated occurrence rating (1–10) after implementation of the recommended action. Reflects the reduced likelihood of the failure cause occurring following corrective action. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: revised_rpn
attributes.description: Recalculated Risk Priority Number (Revised S × Revised O × Revised D) after implementation of the recommended action. Used to verify that the corrective action achieved the desired risk reduction. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field.

attributes.name: revised_severity_rating
attributes.description: Updated severity rating (1–10) after implementation of the recommended action. Severity typically does not change unless a design change eliminates the failure effect. Core AIAG-VDA Step 9 field for post-action re-evaluation.

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Document revision identifier (e.g., A, B, C, 01, 02) tracking the version history of the FMEA in Siemens Teamcenter PLM. Incremented upon each approved change to the FMEA content.

attributes.name: rpn
attributes.description: Risk Priority Number calculated as the product of Severity × Occurrence × Detection ratings (S × O × D). Ranges from 1 to 1000. Used to prioritize failure modes for corrective action. Higher RPN indicates greater risk requiring immediate attention. Stored as a business-critical field per AIAG-VDA methodology.

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the failure mode has a safety-critical or regulatory compliance impact (severity rating 9 or 10). Safety-critical failure modes require mandatory escalation, special controls, and PPAP documentation. Aligned with OSHA and CE Marking requirements.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Description of the boundaries and scope of the FMEA analysis, including what is included and excluded from the analysis. Defines the system boundary, interfaces, and assumptions. Required for AIAG-VDA Step 2 (Structure Analysis).

attributes.name: severity_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating (1–10) assessing the seriousness of the failure effect on the customer or downstream process. A rating of 10 indicates a safety-critical or regulatory non-compliance failure; 1 indicates no discernible effect. Defined per AIAG-VDA severity evaluation criteria. Core AIAG-VDA Step 5 field.

attributes.name: special_characteristic_code
attributes.description: Designation indicating whether the failure mode relates to a special product or process characteristic requiring enhanced control. SC = Special Characteristic; CC = Critical Characteristic; KPC = Key Product Characteristic; KCC = Key Control Characteristic. Drives control plan and inspection plan requirements.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the recommended action must be implemented and verified. Used for action tracking and escalation management in the FMEA review cycle. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of cross-functional team members who participated in the FMEA analysis session. Typically includes representatives from design engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier quality. Required for AIAG-VDA Step 1 documentation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the FMEA document identifying the product, component, or process being analyzed. Used for search, retrieval, and display in PLM and quality management systems.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the FMEA record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental load processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: control_plan
products.description: Manufacturing control plan defining the process controls, inspection frequency, measurement methods, reaction plans, and control limits for each critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristic at each process step. Links to PFMEA and inspection plans. Core APQP deliverable managed per AIAG standards and ISO 9001 clause 8.5.

attributes.name: control_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the control plan record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Control plans are written for specific components. part_name and part_number on control_plan are denormalized fields. Linking to the engineering component master enables direct retrieval of all contro

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Control plans are defined per customer requirements; linking to customer_account enables traceability of customer‑driven control specifications.

attributes.name: fmea_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) ID
attributes.description: Reference to the PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) record from which this control plan characteristic was derived. Ensures traceability between risk analysis and process controls per AIAG APQP linkage requirements.

tag_set.value: Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) ID

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_characteristic. Business justification: A control plan row defines controls for a specific inspection characteristic. The control_plan table contains denormalized characteristic_name, characteristic_number, characteristic_class, and charact

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. Business justification: Control plans are revision-specific per AIAG APQP standard. part_revision on control_plan is a denormalized signal. When an engineering revision changes tolerances or processes, the control plan must

attributes.name: sourcing_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.sourcing_rule. Business justification: Control plans for supplier-provided materials reference the sourcing rule to document inspection/control methods specific to that supplier's process capability. Ensures incoming inspection requirement

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.work_center. Business justification: Control plans define process controls at specific work centers (process_step_name, measurement_method per work center). The existing 'work_center_code' plain attribute is denormalized. A proper FK ena

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the authorized approver (typically Quality Manager or Engineering Manager) who formally approved this control plan revision. Required for ISO 9001 document control compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this control plan revision was formally approved. Provides the authoritative approval event timestamp for document control audit trails and PPAP submission packages.

attributes.name: control_method
attributes.description: The process control technique applied to monitor and control this characteristic (e.g., 'SPC X-bar/R Chart', 'Pre-control Chart', 'Poka-yoke', 'Visual Standard', 'Attribute Control Chart', 'Process Parameter Monitoring'). Core APQP deliverable field.

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is a prevention control (prevents the defect from occurring) or a detection control (detects the defect after it has occurred). Aligns with PFMEA prevention/detection control columns.

attributes.name: cpk_minimum_required
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable Cpk (Process Capability Index) value required for this characteristic to be considered capable. Typically 1.33 for production and 1.67 for critical/safety characteristics per AIAG PPAP requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under ISO 9001 document control and data lineage tracking in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this revision of the control plan becomes active and must be followed on the shop floor. Aligns with the ECO/ECN implementation date in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: error_proofing_method
attributes.description: Description of the poka-yoke or error-proofing device/method applied at this process step to prevent or detect non-conformances (e.g., 'Torque monitoring with automatic shutdown', 'Vision system barcode verification', 'Fixture limit switch'). Reduces reliance on operator inspection.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this control plan revision expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended plans. Used to enforce periodic review cycles mandated by ISO 9001 and customer-specific requirements.

attributes.name: gauge_type
attributes.description: Type or category of measurement instrument or gauge used for this characteristic (e.g., 'Vernier Caliper', 'CMM', 'Go/No-Go Gauge', 'Torque Tester', 'Vision System'). Used for gauge calibration scheduling and MSA planning.

attributes.name: is_ctq
attributes.description: Indicates whether this characteristic is designated as Critical-to-Quality (CTQ), meaning it directly impacts customer satisfaction, safety, or regulatory compliance. CTQ characteristics receive enhanced monitoring and are mandatory in PPAP submissions.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this characteristic is controlled to meet a specific regulatory or certification requirement (e.g., CE Marking, UL, IEC 62443, EPA, OSHA). Drives mandatory retention of inspection records for regulatory audit purposes.

attributes.name: is_safety_characteristic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this characteristic is classified as a safety-critical characteristic (SC) per customer-specific requirements or regulatory mandates. Safety characteristics require 100% inspection or validated error-proofing (poka-yoke) and special PPAP documentation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this control plan record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance in the silver layer.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: The lower statistical process control limit (LCL) for the SPC control chart associated with this characteristic. Calculated as the process mean minus three standard deviations. Triggers reaction plan when breached.

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: The lower engineering specification limit (LSL) for the quality characteristic. Measurements below this value are considered non-conforming. Used in Cp/Cpk process capability index calculations.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Description of the measurement technique or method used to evaluate the characteristic (e.g., 'CMM dimensional measurement', 'Torque wrench with digital readout', 'Visual inspection per drawing'). Supports Measurement System Analysis (MSA) traceability.

attributes.name: nominal_value
attributes.description: The target or nominal engineering specification value for the quality characteristic (e.g., 25.00 mm, 45 Nm). Used as the center point for control limit calculations and SPC charting.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the control plan document, typically formatted as CP-<part/process code>-<sequence>. Used for cross-referencing in APQP packages, PPAP submissions, and SAP QM inspection plans.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control plan document. Drives whether the plan is actively used on the shop floor. Managed through the document control workflow in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Phase classification of the control plan per AIAG APQP methodology: prototype (early design validation), pre-launch (pilot/trial production), or production (full-rate manufacturing). Determines the rigor and scope of controls applied.

attributes.name: process_step_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the manufacturing process step or operation (e.g., 'Welding', 'CNC Machining', 'Final Assembly Inspection'). Provides human-readable context for the control being defined.

attributes.name: process_step_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for the manufacturing process step or operation within the control plan (e.g., 10, 20, 30). Aligns with the process flow diagram and PFMEA step numbering per AIAG standards.

attributes.name: reaction_plan
attributes.description: Prescribed corrective actions to be taken when the process goes out of control or a non-conformance is detected for this characteristic (e.g., 'Stop production, quarantine last 2 hours output, notify quality engineer, initiate NCR'). Mandatory APQP control plan field.

attributes.name: sample_frequency

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of parts or units to be measured per inspection event for this characteristic. Defined per statistical sampling plan (e.g., ANSI/ASQ Z1.4, Z1.9) or engineering judgment. Drives inspection workload planning.

attributes.name: spc_chart_type

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: The upper statistical process control limit (UCL) for the SPC control chart associated with this characteristic. Calculated as the process mean plus three standard deviations. Triggers reaction plan when exceeded.

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: The upper engineering specification limit (USL) for the quality characteristic. Measurements exceeding this value are considered non-conforming. Used in Cp/Cpk process capability index calculations.

attributes.name: checking_aids_status
attributes.description: Status of checking aids (gauges, fixtures, templates) used for part inspection (PPAP Element 14). Confirms that all required checking aids are available, calibrated, and documented.

attributes.name: cpk_minimum

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause determined through failure analysis, supporting CAPA and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: salesforce_case_reference

attributes.name: sap_qm_notification_number

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the specific unit being returned, enabling traceability to manufacturing batch and production history.

attributes.name: supplier_responsibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the root cause is attributable to a supplier defect, triggering supplier quality notification and potential cost recovery.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the returned quantity (each, kilogram, meter, liter, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|LB|M|FT|L|GAL|M2|M3 — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this RMA disposition record was last modified, supporting audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RMA is covered under product warranty terms, affecting cost allocation and supplier recovery.

Captures certificate type (CoC, CoA), issued date, product/material, lot/batch number, inspection lot reference, test results summary, specification compliance statement, authorized signatory, and customer-specific certificate requirements.

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
